threads.body: This finalizes `opentelemetry-util-genai` while every released instrumentation still declares `opentelemetry-util-genai >= 1.2b0.dev` and its oldest requirements still installs the util editable. Once the workspace version is `1.2b0`, `check_deps.py` treats that floor as a prior released version and rejects those editable installs, so the `deps-check` gate will fail. Update the consumers' floors to `>= 1.2b0` and remove the obsolete editable-install workarounds (and their comments) before finalizing the release.
threads.hunk:
